levels.name: Street/platform level: perron 1 (tracks 2/3), perron 2 (tracks 4 and 6), perron 3 (track 7), and perron 4 (track 5, short 129 m, south of the others)
levels.note: Bilag 3.6 heights: perron 1 35/55 cm, track 4 55 cm, track 5 55 cm, tracks 6 and 7 92 cm (S-tog). Wikipedia (da): 4 platforms, 6 platform tracks, 2 of them S-tog; operators DSB and Lokaltog (Køge Bugt-banen, Lille Syd, Østbanen). No owner source gives signposted level names for this station.

answers.question: (no station-specific open questions were listed for Køge)
answers.answer: Station rebuilt 2015–2018 with a wide footbridge across the tracks (Køge Kyst). OSM: footbridge at the south end of the platforms with stairs to perron 1 and perron 4, one lift on the west side; DSB confirms elevator and stairs but gives no positions.
answers._source: https://www.wikiwand.com/da/K%C3%B8ge_Station (Danish Wikipedia), read 2026-10-30; https://www.dsb.dk/trafikinformation/stationer/koge/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract), read 2026-10-30

open: Lifts: OSM maps only one (west side); DSB lists 'Elevator' with no number or position. Whether perron 1, perron 2 and the Lokaltog perron 4 have lifts is not settled.
OSM platform refs ('2;3', '5', one without ref) don't cover perron 2 (tracks 4/6) and perron 3 (track 7).
Which platform the Lokaltog Østbanen uses (track 5/perron 4 by its length and position, but no owner source says so).

Shops near the station in OSM (Lagkagehuset n8133042258, 365discount n8363710421, Køge Stations Apotek n8363710422, Imerco, Lucky Star, Fri BikeShop) are 25–50 m from the platforms; no source says they are in the station, so they are left out.
No station building is described after the 2015 demolition; where the ventesal and toilets are is not given.
No owner station plan found; footbridge name as signposted not found.
